source: 2026-07-03 local source-tree production CLI probes against docwen-ref-tk, docwen-ref-pyside6, and docwen-current
probe_scope: True CLI entrypoint smoke with real DOCX->Markdown and XLSX->Markdown conversions plus one unsupported notes.bad input; no external Office dependency.

notes.bad.expected_current_behavior: prevalidation invalid_input failure is included in JSON batch results but is not sent to runtime
notes.bad.old_system_production_behavior: old source-tree CLIs sniff the text content as markdown and then fail the markdown->md strategy route

docwen-ref-tk.command_shape: uv run docwen convert --to md --batch --json --continue-on-error sample.docx sheet.xlsx notes.bad
docwen-ref-tk.stdout_json_prefix_noise: config-manager debug lines can precede the JSON object

docwen-ref-pyside6.command_shape: uv run docwen convert --to md --batch --json --continue-on-error sample.docx sheet.xlsx notes.bad

docwen-current.command_shape: uv run docwen run --to md --batch --json --continue-on-error sample.docx sheet.xlsx notes.bad
docwen-current.output_path_style: stable files beside inputs, e.g. sample.md and sheet.md
docwen-current.invalid_failure_stage: CLI prevalidation; invalid file is not sent to runtime

focused_scope_decision: For this DOCX/XLSX/bad focused smoke, the old=3/current=2 process exit-code difference is accepted as a stage-specific architecture difference because the user-visible batch projection remains aligned: total=3, success_count=2, failed_count=1, and the bad file is present in results. Current must keep the earlier invalid_input prevalidation boundary and must not send notes.bad to runtime only to reproduce the old later strategy_not_found failure.
comparison_implication: Production CLI evidence now proves all three projects expose a 3-item mixed batch JSON result with two real Markdown outputs and one failed notes.bad row. Current keeps the cleaner prevalidation failure stage documented by the v2 presenter golden, so its process exit code is invalid_input/2 while old production CLIs fail the same bad input later as a markdown->md strategy lookup and return strategy_not_found/3. The focused smoke accepts that stage-specific exit-code difference without closing the broader GOLDEN-006 CLI matrix.
